prompt:
Invent SQL rewrites for metamorphic testing.
A rewrite must leave the result multiset unchanged under bag semantics,
SQL three-valued logic, and duplicate rows.
It must hold on every engine listed here:
duckdb, datafusion, sqlite, postgres

The harness already has these frozen rules. Do not propose their names.
- double_negation: In SQL three-valued logic NOT is involutive: NOT NOT TRUE = TRUE, NOT NOT FALSE = FALSE, and NOT NOT UNKNOWN = UNKNOWN. WHERE retains only TRUE, so wrapping the entire top-level predicate p as NOT (NOT (p)) admits the same rows. The rule does not push NOT through AND, OR, comparisons, or subqueries.
- demorgan: In SQL three-valued logic, NOT (p AND q) equals (NOT p) OR (NOT q) and NOT (p OR q) equals (NOT p) AND (NOT q), including when p or q is UNKNOWN. The rule fires only when the WHERE predicate is exactly that binary form. An AND that belongs to BETWEEN, and an AND or OR inside CASE, brackets, or braces, is syntax rather than this connective, so those shapes are declined. Mixed AND/OR, n-ary chains, a lambda arrow, and a NOT that covers only part of the predicate are left untouched.
- case_to_coalesce: CASE WHEN x IS NOT NULL THEN x ELSE y END equals COALESCE(x, y) when both copies of x are the same expression: a NULL x yields y on both sides, and a non-NULL x yields x. The CASE evaluates x twice and COALESCE once, so this holds for deterministic x. A different THEN expression, IS NULL, extra WHEN arms, and simple CASE are not this form.

Propose templates of only two kinds.
query_wrap contains exactly one {q}, and {q} stands for the whole statement.
predicate_wrap contains one, two, or three {p}.
Each {p} stands for the top-level WHERE predicate.
When a predicate template is applied, that predicate is wrapped in parentheses.
A template must not contain a semicolon, a comment (-- or /*),
a data-modifying keyword (ALTER, CALL, COPY, CREATE, DELETE, DROP, EXECUTE, GRANT, INSERT, MERGE, REVOKE, TRUNCATE, UPDATE),
or any brace other than the placeholders.
query_wrap must not contain {p}. predicate_wrap must not contain {q}.
Examples:
query_wrap: SELECT * FROM ({q}) AS llm_sub
query_wrap: WITH llm_cte AS ({q}) SELECT * FROM llm_cte
predicate_wrap: ({p}) IS TRUE

Rules already accepted, in acceptance order.
Do not repeat a rule id, and do not repeat the same kind and template.
(none)

Propose at most 3 rules.
Reply with one JSON object and no other text.
Use this shape:
{"rules": [{"name": "snake_case", "kind": "query_wrap", "template": "...", "argument": "why the multiset is unchanged"}], "prediction": [{"rule": "snake_case", "equivalent_on": ["duckdb", "datafusion", "sqlite", "postgres"], "why": "..."}]}
name is 1 to 36 characters from lowercase letters, digits, and underscores.
kind is query_wrap or predicate_wrap.
argument is a non-empty string.
This is proposal round 1 of 3.
